plugins.name: claude-vision
plugins.description: Let Claude see your screen or webcam via snapshots, region captures, short videos, or a continuous background watch with live queries.

plugins.name: claude-vision-full
plugins.description: claude-vision plus local image captioning: a small VLM (SmolVLM) runs continuously during watch mode, producing a text log Claude can read instead of raw frames — cuts token cost on long retrospective queries by ~50x.
